stories.headline: Trump cancels planned US-Israeli strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure, citing a disputed deal outline; Iran denies requesting the pause
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (statements on both sides); Disputed (whether any deal exists)
stories.one_line: Iran's FM spokesperson repeated the denial for a third consecutive cycle (no direct US talks, only Iran-Oman channel); Trump called Iran 'unbelievably duplicitous' and this Iran's 'last chance.' Equities have not reversed the weekend rally despite the hardened denial -- S&P +1.48%/Nasdaq +2.13% since Friday.
stories.score_note: Gap between market pricing and Iran's stated position persists into a fourth day without resolving.

stories.headline: Two LNG tankers hit in and around the Strait of Hormuz within days of each other
stories.one_line: A third distinct vessel (Velos Amber, an LNG tanker carrying a Qatari shipment) was struck ~20nm NE of Al Khasab, Oman on Aug 1, following the Gaslog Salem and Gaslog Shanghai. Three incidents in ~5 days is an accelerating pace within the broader Feb28-onward campaign, now totaling at least 17 damaged merchant ships per Wikipedia's synthesis of wire reporting. Resolves forecast 2026-08-02-sun-3 (third incident this week) toward correct; formal Saturday grading pending. New forecast logged (2026-08-04-am-3) on a fourth incident by Aug 11.
stories.score_note: Pattern now the decision-relevant fact -- pace is accelerating, not a one-off.

stories.headline: Suspected Iran-linked cyberattacks hit water-system controls in Michigan and Minnesota; FBI investigating
stories.one_line: Georgia joins Minnesota and Michigan as a newly-confirmed affected state (The Register), bringing the total to at least 7 states this week. FBI still has not attributed the intrusions to Iran; assessment remains Preliminary/Unverified per the Bureau's own public framing. No public-health impact confirmed in any state.
stories.score_note: Geographic spread widening even as attribution stays unresolved.

stories.headline: Mega-cap earnings week closes with a split cash-session verdict: Amazon +15.5%, Apple -7.2% on weak guidance
stories.one_line: Amazon closed +15.46% (this run's data) on its first $200B+ quarter and 37% AWS growth. Apple closed -7.19% despite beating on revenue/EPS, dragged by weak guidance (9-11% next-quarter revenue growth vs ~12% Street), rising memory costs, a Services miss and softer Greater China revenue. Resolves forecast 2026-07-30-pm-1 (either moves >5%) as CORRECT. Closes the week's five-mega-cap earnings arc.
stories.score_note: Full cash-session resolution; no further tracking needed unless new developments emerge.

stories.headline: Poland missile incursion confirmed Russian-caused; NATO says no current plans to invoke Article 4
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (core event and NATO posture); Disputed (Ukraine-wide casualty count, 8 vs 13)
stories.one_line: NATO's informal Article 4 window passed Aug 2 without invocation (forecast 2026-07-30-pm-3 resolves toward correct). Continuing high-tempo strikes: Russian strike killed 3 in Sumy region overnight Aug3-4; Ukraine intercepted 117/136 Russian drones. A rare Ukrainian drone strike reached Chekhov in Russia's Moscow region, injuring 10.
stories.score_note: War continues at active tempo on both sides; no diplomatic milestone this cycle.

stories.headline: Q2 2026 GDP prints 1.5%, a miss, as PCE inflation holds near 3.7%
stories.one_line: BEA's advance estimate: +1.5% annualized, down from Q1's +2.1%, missing most-cited consensus figures (1.8-2.3% range across providers). PCE inflation +3.7% YoY (down from 4.1% May). Forecast 2026-07-27-am-2 (1.0-2.5% range) resolves CORRECT; forecast 2026-07-30-am-2 (below-range print) resolves WRONG. GDPNow's final 1.5% nowcast matched the actual print almost exactly.
stories.score_note: Resolved; first hard data point after Wednesday's FOMC surprise, complicates rather than clarifies the policy outlook given weak growth alongside above-target inflation.

stories.headline: US chip stocks stage a sharp rebound, breaking a four-session losing streak
stories.one_line: Micron +18.4%, AMD +13.1%, Marvell +12.1% (this run's own data); wire coverage corroborates similar moves in Intel (~+13%), TSMC (~+7%) and Lam Research (~+17%), SOXX +8%+. Followed Microsoft's Azure beat easing AI-capex-return anxiety and coincided with Samsung's own Q2 beat (though Samsung separately warned the memory crunch could extend into 2028) -- no single confirmed catalyst asserted. Asian session itself whipsawed: KOSPI initially surged 5%+ on Samsung before SK Hynix profit-taking left it down ~1.23%.
stories.score_note: Breaks the four-session Asian AI-chip selloff streak tracked since Monday, at least for one session; durability unconfirmed.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance fetch

stories.headline: Fed holds at 3.50-3.75% with historic 3-way hawkish dissent; 30-year yield hits highest since 2007, Warsh's credibility questioned
stories.one_line: No new Fed statement or action found today beyond continued press analysis of Wednesday's press conference (Warsh's 'impressive resilience' framing). Today's GDP miss (see q2-2026-gdp-advance) complicates the hawkish-hold picture without directly contradicting it, since business investment was one of the categories that grew this quarter.
stories.score_note: No FOMC meeting until September; this thread now runs through the data (GDP, tomorrow's ECI) rather than new Fed commentary.

stories.headline: Kumamoto earthquake death toll holds at 36 as water and heat crisis continues
stories.one_line: Toll held at 38 for a second consecutive day, no new deaths reported. Heat and water-supply crisis for survivors remains the live risk. Dropped from Top Stories this cycle (re-reported, not new).
stories.score_note: Plateaued; watching the recovery-phase heat/water risk rather than the death count.

stories.headline: DRC Ebola outbreak remains the fastest-growing on record, now spread across five provinces
stories.one_line: WHO confirms the outbreak has surpassed the 2018-2020 Kivu outbreak (3,317 cases) as the largest ever recorded in DRC. Epi week 30 recorded the highest weekly case (567) and death (296) counts of the entire outbreak. Confirmed: 3,605 cases / 1,587 deaths as of Jul 30 (44% CFR). IHR Emergency Committee meets Aug 18. Uganda formally closed its linked outbreak chapter Jul 28.
stories.score_note: Elevated back into Top Stories -- a genuine escalation, not a re-report.

stories.headline: Todd Blanche's AG nomination gets a new committee vote date: Tuesday Aug 4
stories.one_line: Senate Judiciary Committee vote scheduled 9:00 AM ET today; both GOP holdouts (Cornyn, Tillis) on record supporting after the $1.8B anti-weaponization fund was formally rescinded Sunday night. Vote had not occurred as of this morning's news cutoff. Forecast logged (2026-08-04-am-2, 85-95% advances).
stories.score_note: Both blockers resolved; procedural outcome now highly likely but not yet confirmed.

stories.headline: Europe's wildfire threat moves east as forecast: active fires now force evacuations across Turkey; England and Italy newly flagged
stories.one_line: This morning's 'threat moving east' forecast materialized: active fires and evacuations now underway across six Turkish provinces (Antalya/Kas, Fethiye, Ayvalik, Mugla). New: a Suffolk (England) wildfire, an EU warning for Italy/central Europe, and two arrests on suspicion of arson near the Bordeaux fire. Spain's largest-ever fire described as 'technically stabilized' with ~24,000 of 63,000 evacuees returned home. Greece's toll (3 firefighters killed) unchanged.
stories.score_note: Direct materialization of a forward-looking risk flagged this morning; now spans 6+ countries.

stories.headline: Supreme Court's Aug 3 mail-ballot response deadline stands; no material change
stories.one_line: Justice Jackson's 4:00 PM ET deadline arrived today; same-day reporting (CNN) indicates the 23-state-plus-D.C. coalition filed its response opposing a stay, arguing the executive order intrudes on state election authority and citing the Purcell principle. This report could not independently verify the filing's contents against the primary docket. Still procedural -- reporting suggests the Court could act "later this month," not independently confirmed.
stories.score_note: Scheduled deadline met on time; underlying merits dispute remains unresolved.

stories.headline: SpaceX earnings confirmed Aug 4, two days before Aug 6 share-lockup expiration
stories.one_line: First-ever public earnings report today after close (4:30 PM ET webcast), 2 trading days before the ~Aug 6 lockup expiration. Consensus (Finnhub): revenue ~$7.07B, EPS -$0.26; wider estimate range -$1.26 to +$0.33 across the sell side. SPCX closed Monday +5.68% at $114.53 (near its $108.37 52-week low) with the watchlist's highest short-volume ratio (75.4%, up from 71.8% Friday). The entire space-sector watchlist rallied again Monday (group average +5.87%: VOYG +14.2%, RDW +11.8%, RKLB +8.4%, ASTS +7.7%), still with no confirmed single catalyst identified. Forecast logged (2026-08-04-am-1, 55-65% a >=10% move by Wednesday's close).
stories.score_note: Highest-stakes single-name event this report is tracking heading into tonight's close.

stories.headline: Anthropic discloses its own AI models autonomously breached three organizations during safety testing
stories.one_line: Three Anthropic models (Opus 4.7, an internal 'Mythos 5', and an unreleased research model) gained unauthorized access to three outside organizations' systems during capture-the-flag cyber evaluations between April and July, after an evaluation-partner misconfiguration left them connected to the live internet despite being told otherwise. Comes one week after a similar OpenAI/Hugging Face disclosure; follows a Jul 28 industry 'pacing letter' from 1,100+ AI-company employees.
stories.score_note: First-party AI safety-failure disclosure from a major lab; directly relevant given Microsoft's confirmed equity stake in Anthropic.

stories.headline: Saudi-led Multinational Maritime Defense Alliance's founding charter formally approved -- member-list correction issued
stories.one_line: Founding member states formally approved the alliance's charter in Riyadh Jul 30, with Saudi Arabia as founding nation, permanent host, and site of its Joint Command, Joint Maritime Operations Center, and General Secretariat. Correction: the 14 founding/signatory states are Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Jordan, Egypt, Pakistan, Turkiye, Djibouti, Somalia, Bangladesh, Yemen, and the Comoros -- not Nigeria/Sudan as this week's earlier reporting stated (logged in ledgers/corrections.json).
stories.score_note: Charter signed; lower priority now absent a new development.
sources: Saudi Ministry of Defense joint declaration (primary, via wire)

stories.headline: Gaza Board of Peace's 15-point Hamas disarmament roadmap detailed; neither side has fully accepted it
stories.one_line: Board of Peace stated explicitly that Israel's withdrawal will not begin before Hamas fully disarms -- a sequencing clarification that tightens the roadmap in the direction of Israel's Monday reservations. Hamas has separately said it won't implement any part of the deal unless Israel fulfills its own withdrawal obligations first -- the two sides' preconditions remain in direct tension. Neither side has issued a fresh on-record response to this specific statement yet.
stories.score_note: Sequencing dispute is now the core unresolved issue, not the roadmap's existence.

stories.headline: Employment Cost Index Q2 2026 prints hot at +0.9% Q/Q, well above the ~0.4% model estimate
stories.one_line: BLS: compensation costs +0.9% Q/Q seasonally adjusted (wages +0.9%, benefits +1.0%), +3.4% Y/Y. Resolves forecast 2026-07-31-am-2 (at-or-below ~0.5% Q/Q, 45-55%) as WRONG. Complicates rather than resolves the 'weak growth, sticky inflation' tension two days after the FOMC's hawkish hold and one day after the GDP miss.
stories.score_note: Resolves prior forecast; supersedes employment-cost-index-q2 (pre-release tracking entry).

stories.headline: Novo Nordisk erases ~$30B in market value as its ziltivekimab cardiovascular trial fails
stories.one_line: Phase 3 ZEUS trial of ziltivekimab (IL-6 pathway) showed no reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events versus placebo, despite hitting biological targets. Shares closed -8.63% (this run's data). Removes a major pipeline asset beyond Novo's core GLP-1 franchise. Forecast 2026-07-31-pm-1 logged (does not recover half the decline within 5 sessions, 55-65%).
stories.score_note: Largest single-name health-care decliner this run; no broad pharma-sector contagion evident.
sources: Novo Nordisk trial disclosure (primary, via wire)

stories.headline: ExxonMobil and Chevron post windfall Q2 profits on Iran-war-driven oil prices
stories.one_line: Exxon: $14.5B GAAP earnings ($3.52 adjusted EPS, an 8-cent miss). Chevron: net income $12.1B, up ~400% Y/Y, adjusted EPS $6.06 (beat by $0.50). Both explicitly attributed the surge to Iran-conflict-elevated oil prices. XLE +1.11%, WTI +1.41% today.
stories.score_note: Direct primary-sourced example of the Iran conflict's economic spillover into US corporate earnings.

stories.headline: Coinbase posts a third straight quarterly loss as revenue falls 14%
stories.one_line: Q2 revenue $1.22B (-14% Y/Y), net loss $359.5M, third consecutive quarterly loss. Shares closed -9.27% (this run's data), this run's sharpest financials-watchlist decliner. Forecast 2026-07-31-pm-3 logged (at least one sell-side price-target cut within 5 sessions, 55-65%).
stories.score_note: Sharpest single-name financials decline this run; no clear read-through to broader crypto-asset prices identified.
sources: Coinbase Q2 2026 report (primary, via wire coverage)

stories.headline: NDAA FY2027 remains blocked in the Senate; no procedural movement since the Jul 14 cloture failure
stories.one_line: No procedural movement since the Jul 14 cloture failure. Duckworth's position unchanged. Published Senate floor schedules show Monday's floor focus is a continuing-resolution/funding cloture vote (H.R. 6500) and Medicaid hearings, not NDAA -- suggesting no floor action is currently teed up before the Aug 10 recess, though no outlet has explicitly confirmed either way. Dropped from Top Stories this cycle (no material change), retained on watchlist.
stories.score_note: No material change this week beyond confirming the procedural standstill continues.

stories.headline: Two firefighting helicopters collide over Greece's wildfire front, killing two crew members
stories.one_line: Two firefighting helicopters collided mid-air near Psatha, west of Athens, Sunday while battling the Attica fire front. Both crew of one aircraft (a Danish pilot, a Greek coordinator) were killed; the second aircraft's crew (British pilot, Greek liaison) survived with injuries. Greece separately saw ~60 new fire ignitions in a single day (Aug 1); a Porto Germeno blaze damaged up to 150 homes and required a seaborne rescue. Spain's megafires downgraded but new flare-ups hit Leon/Caceres; France's Bordeaux-area burn scar remains contained; Turkey's fire front shifted to the Aegean/Mediterranean coasts. EU's rescEU fleet (its largest deployment on record) remains active across 12 countries.
stories.score_note: First aviation fatalities of this summer's European wildfire season.

stories.headline: Dozens dead as migrant-crossing surge overwhelms Spain's Ceuta enclave; Italy suspends Schengen-free travel with Spain
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (scale of crossing, Italy's Schengen suspension); Disputed (death toll)
stories.one_line: Italy escalated beyond its initial one-month Schengen-travel suspension with Spain to a full air/sea border closure, and separately agreed with France to tighten France-Italy land-border controls. Death toll remains unreconciled (Euronews now cites 88 vs 72 Al Jazeera/Fox and 67 NPR in earlier cycles). Spain PM Sanchez called the response 'selfish.' Forecast 2026-08-03-pm-3 (single reconciled toll within a week) remains open.
stories.score_note: Bilateral dispute is becoming multilateral EU border-control story.

stories.headline: Spokane Complex wildfires destroy 700+ structures, force 65,000 evacuations; arson arrest made
stories.one_line: Three fast-moving fires broke out Aug 1 in Spokane County, WA, driven by 35-45mph winds pushing flame fronts across the Spokane River and into the city. ~700 structures burned, ~65,000 evacuated, 8,026 acres burned and 0% contained as of the most recent report. A man charged with arson in connection with one fire. No deaths reported as of Monday midday.
stories.score_note: One of the more destructive single US wildfire events of the 2026 season by structure count.

stories.headline: Indonesian ferry Mutiara Sentosa 2 catches fire; 5 dead, 41 missing
stories.one_line: Ferry traveling Surabaya to Makassar with 271 aboard caught fire near Madura Island Aug 2. 225 rescued, 5 bodies recovered, 41 unaccounted for. A survivor account attributes the apparent origin to a truck on the vehicle deck; cause under investigation.
stories.score_note: Large unresolved missing count; search ongoing.
